items.title: NUS Medicine, DayOne and Cortical Labs Unveil Biological Data Center Prototype in Singapore
items.body: https://medicine.nus.edu.sg/news/nus-medicine-dayone-and-cortical-labs-unveil-biological-data-center-prototype-in-singapore/ "...conventional silicon chips, it uses “wetware” — living biological neurons derived from stem cells — to process information and support AI systems. In contrast to traditional data centres, which depend on energy-intensive servers, biological computing offers the potential for significantly greater efficiency by harnessing brain-like organoids that can operate using only a fraction of the power required by digital computers." submitted by /u/coffee_tea_sympathy [link] [comments]
